_HowToUse.Routes: Routes, dates and supplier are set ONCE in Defaults.Routes, one entry per trip type (ONE_WAY, ROUND_TRIP, MULTI_CITY). A scenario only says "Trip": "ROUND_TRIP" and uses that route. Need another route (e.g. a 3-leg multi-city)? Add it under Defaults.Routes with its own name and a "Trip", then put "Route": "<that name>" in the scenario.
_HowToUse.Journeys: List of {From, To, Date (DD/MM/YYYY)}: 1 for one-way, 2 for round trip (the site fills the return route, only its Date is used), 2+ legs for multi-city. A route's Supplier (text on the flight card) overrides Defaults.Supplier when filled in; empty everywhere = first flight in the results.
_HowToUse.Scenarios: Every object in Scenarios is one test run. Add a block to add a test; set Enabled=false to park it. Run some: -Dscenario="OW*" (name, * wildcard, comma-separated) or -Dtags=smoke. Change supplier for a run: -Dsupplier="Fly Nas NDC". Dry run any scenario: -Dflow=NO_BOOKING.
_HowToUse.Flow: BOOK = book from wallet and verify passenger page, confirmation, e-ticket, itinerary. HOLD_THEN_PAY = hold, verify, pay after hold, verify. NO_BOOKING = verify the passenger page only and stop (no wallet cost).
_HowToUse.Rules: Bundle: {Journey, Pick}. Meals: {Passenger, Journey, Segment, Pick}. Baggage: {Passenger, Journey, Pick}. ChangeBeforeBooking: same plus Type (MEAL | BAGGAGE) - re-selects after the first picks. Clear: {Type, Passenger, Journey, Segment} - removes picks. A plain string ("Meals": "FIRST") means every passenger / journey / segment.
_HowToUse.Values: Passenger = ALL | ADULTS | CHILDREN | 1, 2, ... (infants never get ancillaries). Journey = ALL | LAST | 1, 2, ... (one-way 1; round trip 1 outbound, 2 return; multi-city one per leg). Segment = ALL | LAST | 1, 2, 3 (legs inside a journey; direct = 1 only). Pick = FIRST..TENTH | LAST (position in the dropdown, or 1..10) | exact option name (Value Flex, SFML, 20Kg Baggage) | CHEAPEST_PAID | MOST_EXPENSIVE | FREE (meals/baggage) | NONE.
_HowToUse.Order: Rules are applied top to bottom; a later rule overrides an earlier one for the same card. Missing fields mean ALL (Pick missing = NONE).
_HowToUse.NotOffered: A rule that matches nothing on the flight (no bundles, Segment 2 on a direct flight, THIRD when only 2 options) is logged and skipped. A BOOK/HOLD scenario is skipped before booking when nothing it asked for exists. An exact option name that isn't offered fails and lists the offered options.
_HowToUse.Rounding: Defaults.Rounding.BaseFare / Taxes = UP (default) | DOWN | NEAREST | NONE: how the system rounds the Base fare total and the Taxes total (summed over all passengers) before adding ancillaries, e.g. UP: 12,781.8 -> 12,782. Every expected total uses it.
_HowToUse.Expect: Negative checks (use with NO_BOOKING): BUNDLE_REQUIRED, INFANT_HAS_NO_TAB, CLEAR_RESTORES_PRICE (clears the Clear rules, or everything when Clear is empty, and checks the price goes back).
